entities.summary: Paul Nobuo Tatsuguchi , sometimes mistakenly referred to as Nebu Tatsuguchi, was a Japanese soldier and surgeon who served in the Imperial Japanese Army (IJA) during World War II. He was killed during the Battle of Attu on Attu Island, Alaska, United States, on May 30, 1943.
